text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D2","page":1,"quote":"⌀10 H7"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"E.N.P."}],"comment":"The ⌀10 H7 bore (D2) is a tight fit with a 0.015 mm tolerance band, but no allowance is made for the E.N.P. plating thickness specified in the title block. The plating will reduce the bore diameter and cause the fit to be too tight or prevent assembly; the designer should add a pre-plate undersize dimension or note specifying the required bore size before plating.","recommended_correction":"Specify the pre-plating bore dimension so that after E.N.P. the finished size falls within ⌀10 H7, or add a note calling out the plating thickness allowance on this feature."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"--"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N6","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :- 1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 28-32 HRC. 2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Note N6 specifies toughening to 28-32 HRC but does not state at which manufacturing stage the heat treatment applies (e.g., before final machining or before surface treatment). Without a defined sequence the machinist cannot plan operations correctly, risking distortion of finished features or inability to machine hardened material; the designer should update N6 to specify the process stage for the heat treatment.","recommended_correction":"Revise note N6 to state when the heat treatment is to be performed relative to machining and surface treatment (for example, 'TO BE TOUGHENED TO 28-32 HRC AFTER ROUGH MACHINING AND BEFORE FINAL GRINDING')."}]}
